public_spec:
Title: cancel_invoice: restore stock on open invoices

Behavior requirements:
- cancel_invoice accepts an invoice identifier for an invoice in OPEN status.
- Upon successful cancellation of an OPEN invoice, set invoice status to CANCELLED.
- On cancellation of an OPEN invoice, restore stock quantities for all line items in the invoice to their pre-invoice state.
- Cancellation request for an invoice in any status other than OPEN (e.g., PAID, CANCELLED, DRAFT) must fail with an appropriate error.
- Return a structured success response indicating cancellation and stock restoration, or a standardized error response indicating reason for failure.

Edge cases:
- Attempting to cancel an invoice that does not exist returns a not-found error.
- Attempting to cancel an already CANCELLED invoice returns a conflict/invalid-state error.
- An OPEN invoice with line items that reference non-stockable products should only restore stock for stockable items; non-stockable items are ignored in stock adjustments.
- Concurrent cancellation requests for the same OPEN invoice should be handled idempotently or serialized to avoid double stock restoration.
- Stock restoration must consider current inventory constraints (e.g., warehouse, lot/serial tracking) and update all affected stock records atomically with the cancellation transaction.

Acceptance criteria:
- Open invoice cancellation succeeds: status becomes CANCELLED and stock quantities for all stockable line items are increased to reflect cancellation.
- None

Non-goals:
- Cancelling PAID invoices or invoices with partial payments via this path.
- Reopening or un-cancelling cancelled invoices.
- Partial cancellation of an invoice (only some line items) via this path.

Testable assertions:
- Given an OPEN invoice with stockable line items, after cancel_invoice, invoice.status == CANCELLED and stock levels increased by the quantity in the invoice.
- Given a PAID invoice, cancel_invoice returns an error indicating only OPEN invoices can be cancelled.
- Given a non-existent invoice id, cancel_invoice returns a not-found error.
- Given an already CANCELLED invoice, cancel_invoice returns an invalid-state error.
